Physical Development

Physical Fitness

Physical Health and Well-Being
Demonstrates personal care and hygiene skills.

Physical Safety
Demonstrates awareness and understanding of safety rules.
Verbalizes and demonstrates safety rules (e.g., bus safety, holding an adult’s hand when walking on sidewalks or near a street).

Participates in fire evacuation drills, understands what the alarm bell is and the need to go to a safe location, etc.
Explains how to get help in emergency situations (e.g., communicates their guardian’s name).
